beats.text: Six habits of people everyone just seems to like.
One. They remember the small details — your dog's name, the trip you mentioned once.
Two. They listen to understand, not to wait for their turn to talk.
Three. They make others feel smart and seen, instead of trying to look impressive.
Four. They're generous with credit and sparing with complaints.
Five. They're warm before they're clever. People forget facts but remember how you made them feel.
Six. They're the same person to everyone — no switching masks by status.
Likeability isn't charm or looks. It's mostly just making other people feel genuinely valued.
